title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not part of the 1976 divided-power de Rham notes. It is a typed page (p. 100) of Grothendieck's Exposé IX of SGA 7 I, 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie', from the seminar of 1967–69 published in LNM 288 (1972). It appears to have been reused as scrap paper; the neighbouring handwritten pages, on graded C-S-modules and truncation adjoints, are unrelated.

Section 9.1 sets up the monodromy pairing.
- Setting: S is the spectrum of a henselian DVR with fraction field K, and A_K is an abelian variety with dual A'_K. A_K has semistable reduction if and only if A'_K does.
- Character lattices: semistable reduction makes the special fibres A_0 and A'_0 of the Néron models extensions of abelian varieties by tori. This gives twisted-constant Z-modules M and M' on S, the character groups of the maximal tori, both of rank r.
- Splitting: M and M' become constant, isomorphic to Z^r, after a finite étale cover of S. No cover is needed if k is separably closed.
- ℓ-adic versions: M_ℓ = M ⊗ Z_ℓ and M'_ℓ = M' ⊗ Z_ℓ. Their geometric meaning is given by (5.5.7) and (5.5.8), which relate them to the fixed, toric and finite parts of the Tate module.
- Goal: define a canonical pairing u_ℓ : M_ℓ ⊗ M'_ℓ → Z_ℓ. It is built from the pro-ℓ Barsotti–Tate groups T_ℓ(A^0) and T_ℓ(A'^0), and in fact from the generic fibre T_ℓ(A_K) alone.
- Case ℓ = p: this needs Tate's full faithfulness theorem for p-divisible groups ([33, th. 4]), so for now only unequal characteristic is covered.
- Case ℓ ≠ p: the pairing can equivalently be read off from the Galois module U = T_ℓ(A_{K̄}), via the action of inertia. This is the classical monodromy pairing; in the semistable case the inertia action on T_ℓ is unipotent of the form 1 + N, and N factors through the pairing.
errors: No mathematical errors. The restriction to unequal characteristic when ℓ = p reflects the state of knowledge in 1967–69. de Jong (1998) later extended Tate's theorem to equal characteristic p.

ideas.what: Canonical monodromy pairing M_ℓ ⊗ M'_ℓ → Z_ℓ between the character groups of the toric parts of the Néron models of A and its dual, for semistable reduction
Using Tate's theorem on p-divisible groups to define the pairing at ℓ = p in mixed characteristic
ideas.modern_name: Tate's full faithfulness theorem for p-divisible groups (later de Jong in equal characteristic)

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a typescript page of the published SGA 7 I Exposé IX §9.1, reused as scrap paper. Its content is fully published and credited to Grothendieck.
transcription_corrections: The page is the typed SGA 7 Exp. IX, p. 100, not part of the handwritten de Rham notes.
The second module in 9.1 is underlined in the original: read 'M' et M'' as the sheaves M and M'.
The handwritten marks '3 [?] u [?]' at the bottom are stray marginal annotations, not mathematics.
The page numbers 418 and 297 are archival stamps.
